description:

Deliver banking and payments integrations: direct debit, refunds, credit card, BPAY and payment gateway reconciliation with Australian banking partners. Deliver government and third-party integrations: Centrelink/Services Australia concession verification (batch and real-time), Centrepay, Australia Post BillPay, SOAP-based land information services, electronic planning and referrals, and address validation. REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE 7+ years integration development, with 3+ years hands-on Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Functions). Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) or Azure Solutions Architect. Strong C#/.NET, REST and SOAP web services, XML/JSON transformation, and batch or file-based integration (CSV, fixed-width, SFTP). Experience integrating Salesforce via REST, Bulk and Platform Events, and with financial or billing systems. Solid grounding in integration error handling, reconciliation and observability not just happy-path delivery. CI/CD for Azure (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) and ARM/Bicep or Terraform. title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Note - Shift Timings (6:30 PM to 3:30 AM IST) 
 About the Role 
 We're looking for a senior Infrastructure Engineer to lead the migration of complex, business-critical systems into Microsoft Azure including the move from traditional VDI platforms to Windows 365 Cloud PCs without disrupting the operations that depend on them. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll own the architecture *and* the execution: mapping dependencies, building the migration roadmap, writing the rollback plan, and then doing the work. If you've navigated a large hybrid Active Directory estate through a real cloud transformation and know where the landmines are, this role is built for you.
 You'll work across hybrid identity, cloud infrastructure, virtual desktop, and modern endpoint management, partnering closely with security and business stakeholders throughout. 
 What You'll Do: Serve as technical lead and subject matter expert across hybrid infrastructure, cloud, VDI, and modern endpoint initiatives Administer and optimize Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, and Exchange Online Lead endpoint management using Microsoft Intune (MDM/MAM) Plan and execute migrations of business-critical workloads to Azure, including VDI-to-Windows 365 Cloud PC transitions Validate that application, identity, network, and security dependencies remain intact post-migration Design, implement, and maintain Conditional Access policies aligned to Zero Trust principles Partner with security and business teams to secure access to Microsoft 365 services Build migration roadmaps, risk assessments, validation plans, and rollback strategies Tune environments for performance, resiliency, scalability, and cost Produce technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and runbooks Mentor junior engineers and raise the technical bar across the team 
 Required: Strong enterprise-scale experience with on-premises Active Directory Proven Azure migration experience on business-critical systems Hands-on administration of Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, and Exchange Online all three are essential Endpoint management experience with Microsoft Intune (MDM/MAM) Solid working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 stack: Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Office apps Deep understanding of Conditional Access policies and identity-based security controls, including automation of policy deployment Strong grasp of hybrid identity, networking, and security architecture Track record of keeping business-critical workloads running with minimal downtime 
 Preferred: Infrastructure-as-Code experience (Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation) Hands-on Windows 365 Cloud PC experience AWS exposure alongside Azure Email security tooling experience (Proofpoint or similar) Relevant certifications in cloud, identity, or VDI Background in regulated or security-focused environments

Key Skills: Azure,Entra ID,Cloud,VDI,Intune,Microsoft 365,Hybrid Infrastructure,Endpoint

title: Genesys Cloud Engineer
description:
Working with us Fully remote, with a minimum 4-hour daily overlap with US Central Time. A short-written stand-up each day and two live calls a week. We do not run heavy processes. You will need reliable internet, a private working space, and an approved device. Background screening and a confidentiality agreement are required before system access, as our clients are public-sector organizations. Genesys Cloud Engineer Position Summary The Genesys Cloud Engineer is responsible for the implementation, configuration, administration, maintenance, and support of the Genesys Cloud CX platform. This role works closely with business stakeholders, architects, developers, and operations teams to ensure reliable contact center operations and continuous platform optimization. Key Responsibilities Configure and maintain Genesys Cloud CX environments. Create and manage queues, skills, routing methods, schedules, and user configurations. Configure Data Actions, integrations, and web service connections. Manage SIP trunking, telephony, BYOC, and carrier connectivity. Troubleshoot call routing, reporting, and platform-related issues. Support production deployments and change management activities. Monitor system performance and ensure platform availability. Collaborate with developers and architects on solution design. Support disaster recovery and business continuity planning. Provide Tier 2/Tier 3 support and participate in on-call rotations. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience). 3+ years of contact center experience. 2+ years of experience with Genesys Cloud CX. Experience with Architect, Routing, Queues, Skills, Data Actions, and Reporting. Knowledge of SIP, VoIP, and telephony concepts. Experience with REST APIs and JSON.
